subject: Turning an alcove into a workspace
hook: Built-in desk or freestanding one for your alcove? Here's the honest trade-off.
ig:
Built-in desk or freestanding one for your alcove? Here's the honest trade-off.

A: Built-in desk
It runs wall to wall, so you get the full width as worktop, shelves above at the right height and a cable route built in. Nothing to catch dust in the gaps. The trade-off: it's part of the house, so it stays if you move.

B: Freestanding desk
You can take it with you or swap rooms round later. The trade-off: standard sizes rarely match an alcove, leaving gaps either side that fill up with clutter and cables.

If you're settled in the house and working from it regularly, A usually makes more sense. If you're likely to move in a year or two, B can be the practical choice.

How long do you think you'll be in your current home? Comment A or B with your answer.
